name: Slack
author: Jan Renz
description: Slack channels, DMs and threads in the Omarchy bar and in a window of their own. Needs python3 (standard library only) and a Slack app of yours - see the README. Talks to the Slack Web API and nothing else.

barWidget.description: Unread conversations in a dropdown behind the bar icon; the channels and DMs open in their own window.

schema.label: Workspace name
schema.description: A short name for this sign-in, e.g. work. Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore. It names the token file, not the Slack workspace.

schema.label: Read-state checks per poll
schema.description: How many conversations may be asked 'how much of this have I read' in one poll. The previews themselves cost one search for the whole workspace, so this is only about the unread marks.

schema.label: Order the sidebar by
schema.description: recent puts whatever spoke last at the top of each section; name is Slack's own alphabetical order.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much room the window gives things. Scales the theme's own spacing, so it follows your font size rather than fighting it.

schema.label: Show avatars
schema.description: Pictures are fetched by the helper, cached on disk, and never fetched by the window itself.

schema.label: Show who is around
schema.description: A dot beside each DM. Needs the users:read scope; costs one request per person in view.

schema.label: Stop polling while you are away
schema.description: Slack's rate limits are a budget: a poll costs a search whether or not anybody is at the machine. Nothing is asked of the server while the screen has been idle for five minutes or the machine has no network, and a fetch goes out the moment you come back or reconnect. Anything you ask for by hand still goes out either way. On battery the interval is doubled, and tripled in the power-saver profile.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar. Ignored when a label is set.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Short text shown instead of the icon, e.g. SLACK.

schema.label: Keybinding name for the dropdown
schema.description: A name of your own for this widget's dropdown, so a key can summon it: set slack here and bind `omarchy-shell slack toggle`. Empty means the dropdown opens by clicking the icon alone. The window is separate and always answers to `omarchy-shell shell toggle janrenz.omarchy.slack`.

schema.label: Highlight the bar icon when something is unread
Show the unread count in the bar
schema.description: The number of conversations with something waiting, beside the icon.

schema.label: Notify when a message arrives
schema.description: A desktop notification for each conversation that has something new in it. What was already waiting when the shell started is not announced, and neither is anything you sent yourself.

schema.label: Hand a conversation to your coding agent
schema.description: Adds the a key and an Ask agent button, which open the coding agent you chose in Omarchy on the conversation you are reading. No message text leaves the window - the agent is told which conversation to read and reads it through the same helper this window uses. Off means neither the key nor the button is there, and a draft sent back from an agent is refused.
